signals.city: Bansko Mountain Break / Lucky Bansko Aparthotel

signals.city: Velingrad Spa Retreat / Park Hotel & SPA Vella Hills
signals.reason: Located just 1.5 hours from Plovdiv, Velingrad provides near-zero transit friction. A mid-week September window captures rock-bottom pricing before autumn spa demand peaks, offering reliable warm mineral pools and toddler-friendly amenities regardless of the weather.

signals.city: Antalya Late Season Coast / Sealife Family Resort Hotel
signals.reason: While flying out of Sofia introduces Tier 2 transit friction, the price drop to shoulder-season rates for this dedicated family resort justifies a 7-night stay.
